character.name: REPLACE: how the script refers to her
character.identity: REPLACE: the visible facts that must not drift: age range, face shape, hair length/color/parting, skin tone, build, height cue, glasses/no glasses, distinguishing marks
character.wardrobe: REPLACE: exact garments and colors for the whole film, e.g. plain light-blue crew-neck shirt, dark trousers, no jewelry
character.lighting: REPLACE: the lighting logic she is always seen in, e.g. soft even daylight, no hard shadows on the face
style_constraints: REPLACE: positive style rules copied from direction.visual_system.style_constraints
exclusions: REPLACE: at most three things that must never appear

views.prompt: REPLACE: neutral front view, waist up, plain background, the wardrobe above
REPLACE: three-quarter view, same wardrobe and lighting
REPLACE: full body standing, same wardrobe, shoes visible

shot_recipe.still: Every shot starts as a Codex still generated with the approved views as references plus the shot's own scene prompt (place, action, framing). Review the still before any video spend.
shot_recipe.video: Grok 1.5 image-to-video at 1080P from that single approved still as first_frame; no reference images in the same request (1080P and references are mutually exclusive).
shot_recipe.continuity_alternative: Shots that must continue a movement from a previous shot: Grok 720P reference-to-video with the approved views as reference_image plus the previous shot's last frame (studio.py still) as first_frame, then Magnific upscale to 1080p with a skin-preserving mode. No ESRGAN or face restoration on faces.
shot_recipe.speaking: Shots where she speaks to camera: HeyGen avatar from the approved front view, character_library.py card bound to this sheet.
shot_recipe.pilot: Three shots in three environments (office, meeting room, audience) before approving the series; compare the stills side by side for face, hair and wardrobe drift.
